description: This document runs action on SSAF client on appliance.

Action.description: (Required) The action name that will be executed on the SSAF client.

Region.description: (Required) AWS Region into which you are replicating.

Account.description: (Optional) AWS Account into which you are replicating.

FQDN.description: (Required) A fully qualified domain name, IPv4 address or IPv6 address (uncompressed, using standard notation) of the server you are installing Replication Agent.

Platform.description: (Required) Platform of the server you are installing Replication Agent.

CredentialsSecretArn.description: (Required) ARN of the secret in SecretsManager which contains the credentials of the server you are installing Replication Agent.

DualStackMode.description: (Optional) Whether to install Replication Agent with dualstack (IPv4/IPv6) support.

RemoteActionArn.description: (Optional) ARN of the remote source action.

RemoteActionJobId.description: (Optional) ID of the remote action job.

ScriptContentBase64.description: (Optional) Base64-encoded script to execute on the source server. Required for custom-script action.

ScriptTimeoutSeconds.description: (Optional) Timeout in seconds for the SSM document step. Defaults to 3600.

runCommand:
#!/bin/bash

public_key='{{ClientPublicKey}}'
signature='{{ClientSignature}}'

client_path="/var/lib/aws-migration-connector/ssaf_client"
lock_file_path="/var/lock/ssaf.lock"
lock_timeout=300   # Timeout in seconds

client_download_url='https://aws-application-migration-service-{{Region}}.s3.dualstack.{{Region}}.amazonaws.com/latest/source-automation-client/linux/ssaf-client/ssaf_client'
fallback_client_download_url='https://aws-application-migration-service-{{Region}}.s3.{{Region}}.amazonaws.com/latest/source-automation-client/linux/ssaf-client/ssaf_client'

mgn_print() {
  echo "[MGN] $1" >&2
}

lock_file() {
  mgn_print "Locking file"
  exec {lock_fd}<> "$lock_file_path" || { mgn_print "Error: Failed to open file descriptor"; return 1; }
  flock -w "$lock_timeout" "$lock_fd" || { mgn_print "Error: Failed to acquire lock within the timeout period"; return 1; }
  mgn_print "File locked"
  return 0
}

unlock_file() {
  mgn_print "Unlocking file"
  flock -u "$lock_fd" || { mgn_print "Error: Failed to release lock"; return 1; }
  exec {lock_fd}>&- || { mgn_print "Error: Failed to close file descriptor"; return 1; }
  mgn_print "Lock released"
  return 0
}

validate_signature() {
  local target="${1:-$client_path}"
  openssl dgst -sha256 \
    -sigopt rsa_padding_mode:pss \
    -signature <(echo "$signature" | base64 -d) \
    -verify <(echo "$public_key" | base64 -d) "$target" >/dev/null 2>&1

  if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
    mgn_print "Error: Signature validation failed"
    return 1
  fi
  mgn_print "Signature validation passed"
  return 0
}

download_update() {
  mgn_print "Downloading update"
  tmp_client="$(mktemp -p "$(dirname "$client_path")")" || { mgn_print "Error: mktemp failed"; return 1; }
  if ! curl -fsS -o "$tmp_client" "$client_download_url"; then
    mgn_print "Primary download failed, trying fallback URL"
    if ! curl -fsS -o "$tmp_client" "$fallback_client_download_url"; then
      rm -f "$tmp_client"
      mgn_print "Error: Download failed from both URLs"
      return 1
    fi
  fi
  chmod 0700 "$tmp_client"
  if ! validate_signature "$tmp_client"; then
    rm -f "$tmp_client"
    return 1
  fi
  if ! mv -f "$tmp_client" "$client_path"; then
    rm -f "$tmp_client"
    mgn_print "Error: Failed to move downloaded client into place"
    return 1
  fi
  mgn_print "Downloaded"
  return 0
}

validate_and_update() {
 lock_file || return 1
 validate_signature && unlock_file && return 0
 download_update && unlock_file && return 0
 return 1
}

if ! validate_and_update; then
  mgn_print "Error: Please perform a manual re-installation"
  exit 1
fi

dualstack_arg=""
if [ "{{DualStackMode}}" = "true" ]; then
  dualstack_arg="--dualstack"
fi

"$client_path" \
  --action '{{Action}}' \
  --region '{{Region}}' \
  --account '{{Account}}' \
  --fqdn '{{FQDN}}' \
  --platform '{{Platform}}' \
  --credentials-secret-arn '{{CredentialsSecretArn}}' \
  --remote-action-arn '{{RemoteActionArn}}' \
  --remote-action-job-id '{{RemoteActionJobId}}' \
  --source-server-id '{{SourceServerID}}' \
  --source-server-arn '{{SourceServerArn}}' \
  --user-provided-id '{{UserProvidedID}}' \
  --script-content-base64 '{{ScriptContentBase64}}' \
  $dualstack_arg

exit $?
